title: Granger updates require observed BTC close history
statement: CryptoIntel.on_bar updates Granger causality only when alt-price history is sufficient and BTC close_history contains at least 11 observed close prices; missing or short BTC history is never replaced with a fabricated flat series.
failure_mode: When alt-price history is present but BTC close_history is missing, the engine repeats the current price to fabricate eleven closes and feeds a flat return series into Granger causality, producing an observation that was never supplied by the market-data source.
notes: Preserves the source-data boundary for causal analysis; layer: test-suite
